observation.command:
echo "=== WFS workspace: any remoteows/mapserver? ==="; find /opt/deegree/xplan-services-wfs-workspace -iname "*.xml" | xargs grep -l "mapserver\|RemoteWMS\|remoteows" 2>/dev/null | head
echo "=== WFS workspace datasources ==="; ls -R /opt/deegree/xplan-services-wfs-workspace/datasources 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "=== WFS webapp: check it loaded correct workspace (search log for wfs workspace) ==="
grep -iE "xplan-services-wfs-workspace|workspace.*xplan-services-wfs\b" /opt/tomcat-dienste/logs/catalina.out | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | tail -6
